desktop-drag.description: Dragging files out of FACET into another application (item 9). Its own capability rather than a line in `default`, because the plugin behind it is compiled out on Android — a permission naming a plugin that is not in the binary fails the whole Android build, which is exactly how this file came to exist.

desktop-pip.description: Pop-out windows. They are borderless, so the page moves and resizes its own window, pins it on top or not, and closes it. Nothing here creates a window: only Rust opens pop-outs, so a file shown in one cannot open more.
